CustomObject.description: Settings changes (build 50): one row per setting an admin changed on the Pipeline tab (Git connection, route, orgs, Slack, work tracking, retention, production approval, run signing, What's built lock): who, what, when, old and new value. Secrets are never written: a changed token, key or password shows as "changed". Written by RlySettingsLog after each save; the Pipeline tab shows the last 10 under Recent changes to settings. Kept 90 days: the nightly archive call removes older rows.
CustomObject.label: RLY Settings Change
